question: The partition of Bengal took place in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1905**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idea of partition of Bengal was brought up during the tenure of Lord Curzon for administrative reasons.
 
• Partition of Bengal took place on October 16, 1905.
 
• The reason cited by the British government was that the smaller states can be better administered.
 
• But the actual reason was to shatter the Hindu-Muslim unity.
 
• Bengal was to divide into the following:
 
 
• Eastern Bengal: Eastern part of Bengal and including Assam in it with its capital at Dacca.
 
• Western province: It included the western Bengal, Odisha and Bihar with its capital at Calcutta (Kolkata now).
 
 
 
• The province was to be divided on the following bases:
 
 
• Language: Separating Hindi speaking regions from Bengali speaking regions.
 
• Religion: Western Bengal included Hindu majority areas while the other one had Muslim majority areas.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Anti partition Movement:

 
• Opposing the decision of dividing the state, people came out on the streets of Bengal in protest.
 
• People showcased the Hindu-Muslim unity in various processions.
 
• The day of partition was observed as 'National Day of Mourning'.
 
• People came out on streets singing 'Bande Mataram' and 'Amar Sonar Bangla'.
 
• On the day of Raksha Bandhan Hindus and the Muslims tied rakhis on the wrists of each other as a symbol of Brotherhood.
